name: mono-color-skill
desc: 单色/双色印刷的版式设计系统。首页顶上那张海报按它做的：一张纸、两版油墨，橙色只留给路面那条中线。
desc_en: The two-ink print design system behind the poster up top: one paper, two plates, orange reserved for the road line alone.

name: next.js
desc: 整站的骨架。用 App Router，并且开了静态导出——所以这个站没有后端，构建出来就是一堆 HTML。
desc_en: The whole thing runs on it, App Router with static export — which is why this site has no backend, just files.

name: react
desc: 19 版。它那几条新的 hooks 规则（不许在 effect 里 setState、不许渲染时写 ref、不许渲染里造组件）在这个项目里各踩过一次。
desc_en: v19. Its new hooks rules each caught me out once while building this.

name: tailwindcss
desc: v4，配置写在 CSS 里而不是 js 里。整套黑白灰的色阶就是一组 @theme 变量。
desc_en: v4, configured in CSS rather than JS. The whole grey scale is one @theme block.

name: motion
desc: 页面切换、列表浮现、放松区那几层的淡入。动效克制，尊重系统的「减少动态效果」。
desc_en: Page transitions and reveals. Restrained, and it respects prefers-reduced-motion.

name: next-intl
desc: 中英双语。所有界面文案都在 messages/ 的字典里，两个文件的键必须一一对应，缺一个构建就失败。
desc_en: Bilingual routing and dictionaries. Both files must have identical keys or the build fails.

name: shiki
desc: 文章里代码块的高亮。在构建时就染好色，浏览器不用再下载一个高亮器。
desc_en: Syntax highlighting for code in posts — done at build time, so no highlighter ships to the browser.

name: marked
desc: 把 markdown 渲染成 HTML。文章、关于页、首页那两段引言都走它。
desc_en: Renders the markdown behind every post and page.

name: gray-matter
desc: 读每篇 markdown 顶部那段 front-matter：标题、日期、标签、摘要。
desc_en: Reads the front-matter at the top of each markdown file.

name: sharp
desc: 摄影页的缩略图和展示图、首页那张双色调海报，都是它在本地压出来的。原图不进仓库。
desc_en: Compresses the photo sets and prints the duotone hero, locally. Originals never enter the repo.

name: giscus
desc: 文章评论和留言板。数据存在这个仓库的 GitHub Discussions 里——静态站没有数据库，这是唯一不用后端的办法。
desc_en: Comments live in this repo's GitHub Discussions — the only way to have them without a backend.

name: simple-icons
desc: 工具页那些品牌图标的来源（CC0）。平时是灰的，鼠标移上去才亮起各自的品牌色。
desc_en: Source of the brand marks on the tools page (CC0). Grey until you hover.
